highlights: Older CNC jobs: crossing loops and flat Drill contours now count toward Job Origin, so some jobs saved in 1.0.28 or earlier cut in a new, correct place. Opening one names how far its cut moved.

Safer Marlin jobs: a line the controller skips ends the job, and Pause and network failures send their beam-off first. A busy page no longer stops a healthy job, and Frame waits for a report after Set origin.
Photo engraving has portrait recipes, Auto tones and an On material preview. Trace keeps text marks at any angle, holds hard art in any ink colour and draws large 1-bit curves smoother.

Text frames converted by 1.0.28 are repaired, single-line frames keep their line rule, and output names every missing glyph. Placed tabs follow resizes and Studio rebuilds; full stops and i-dots stay.
Fill pools match what output burns, GRBL Compatible fills get constant-power advice, and a grblHAL Resume left Idle at a job end warns instead of blocking. The A1 Pro uses its homed travel.
Camera setup probes RTSP logins and shows its status in Machine Setup, the phone pairing scanner reads the PC code on every phone, and Studio keeps drawings applied before a crash.
